package rulefixtures

// scenario for string_to_byte_for_single_char_check: `[]byte(s)[0]` or `string(b) == "x"` for single-character comparisons
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario648Positive(input string) string {
	if []byte(input)[0] == '\n' {
		return input[1:]
	}
	if len(input) > 1 && []byte(input)[len(input)-1] == '\n' {
		return input[:len(input)-1]
	}
	return input
}
